evidence.original_label: 2026 年上半年营业收入
evidence.excerpt: 2026 年上半年公司实现营业收入 29.09 亿元，同比下降 30.95%；归母净利润 2.52 亿元，同比下降 35.99%，扣非归母净利润 1.15 亿元，同比下降 68.28%。虽然营收规模有所下滑，但毛利率提升至 48.46%，同比提升 14.72 个百分点，主要是高毛利海外订单占比提升，境外收入 19.84 亿元，同比增长 140.64%，收入占比达到 68.21%。

notes: Investor call record of 25 Aug 2026, rounded narrative figures. The registered H1 2026 report is not in this batch; the filed table is the better source if the integrator wants exact cells.

evidence.original_label: 国有建设用地使用权出让合同价款
evidence.excerpt: 宸微设备与苏州市吴江区自然资源和规划局签订《国有建设用地使用权出让合同》，以人民币 25,567,283.88 元取得一宗国有建设用地使用权，宗地面积为 55,404 平方米，土地用途为工业用地。

notes: Land-use-right purchase by controlled subsidiary 宸微设备科技(苏州)有限公司 for the named Wujiang project, not equipment sales or orders. The executed-contract metric is used under its generic contract-value definition. The source does not state tax inclusion or exclusion. P2 item 6 specifies payment by 17 Oct 2026; the notice does not establish that payment has occurred. Signing is described only as 近日; 28 Aug 2026 is the document-signature date used as the as-of anchor. The reported land area of 55,404 square metres has no compatible land-area metric and is not gross building floor area.
